page_title: BHA 1-3 WHU | Brighton v West Ham 26/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+5' Joao Pedro (Brighton) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
90+3' Pascal Gross (Brighton) takes the corner.
90+2' The ball goes out of play. Brighton are awarded a corner kick.

90+2' Evan Ferguson (Brighton) gets inside the box and tries to beat Alphonse Areola with a measured shot towards the roof of the net, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Brighton.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
89' Thilo Kehrer (West Ham) receives a yellow card for infringement.
88' Anthony Taylor shows a yellow card to Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) for his blatant foul.
88' Brighton win a corner.
88' Joel Veltman (Brighton) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but Alphonse Areola makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
87' The resulting set piece from Brighton is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
86' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
85' David Moyes decides to make a substitution. Lucas Paqueta will be replaced by Danny Ings (West Ham).
84' It is time for a substitution. Pablo Fornals (West Ham) is on for Edson Alvarez.
83' A quickly taken corner by Brighton.
83' Brighton take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
81' 1 - 3 Pascal Gross (Brighton) breaks through before collecting a brilliant pass and producing a precise strike to beat the goalkeeper. The ball went into the bottom left corner.
79' The ball is out of play. Brighton will have a chance to score from a corner.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Michail Antonio trots off the pitch and is replaced by Thilo Kehrer (West Ham).

79' Pascal Gross (Brighton) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the bottom right corner. Alphonse Areola pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
78' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
76' The referee signals a corner kick to West Ham.
76' Brighton are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
74' An attempted cross from Lewis Dunk (Brighton) is cleared.
72' Roberto De Zerbi has decided to make a change. Simon Adingra (Brighton) replaces Solly March.
72' Substitution. James Milner leaves the pitch and is replaced by Joel Veltman (Brighton).
72' Michail Antonio (West Ham) unleashes a shot, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies well wide of the left post.
69' Emerson (West Ham) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
67' The corner is swung in but Brighton can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
66' A corner kick by Brighton is thwarted by the well prepared Alphonse Areola (West Ham).
66' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
63' 0 - 3 Goal! Jarrod Bowen manages to prod the ball to Michail Antonio (West Ham) after a melee inside the box, and he needs no second invitation to slot the ball into the bottom left corner. 0:3.
62' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Michail Antonio (West Ham).
60' Roberto De Zerbi has decided to substitute Billy Gilmour and he is replaced by Adam Lallana (Brighton).
60' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Joao Pedro (Brighton) will replace Danny Welbeck.
59' Lewis Dunk (Brighton) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
58' 0 - 2 Goal! Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 0:2.
55' Lewis Dunk (Brighton) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
53' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the left post.
52' Pascal Gross (Brighton) works the corner short.
51' James Milner (Brighton) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
49' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) wins the ball from the resulting corner but blazes it well over the bar.
49' Pascal Gross (Brighton) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

47' What a save from Alphonse Areola! Evan Ferguson (Brighton) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+5' Solly March (Brighton) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
45+4' James Milner (Brighton) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
45+3' The ball goes out of play and Brighton have been awarded a corner kick.
45+1' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Edson Alvarez (West Ham) was quite harsh and Anthony Taylor didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
45' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) swings in a cross from the corner, but Bart Verbruggen reads it well and gathers the ball.
45' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
44' West Ham fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
43' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
41' A cross into the box from James Milner (Brighton) is cleared.
39' The ball goes out of play. Brighton are awarded a corner kick.
39' Tomas Soucek is leaving the field of play after that knock to his head, as Mohamed Said Benrahma (West Ham) runs on as his replacement.
38' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by James Milner (Brighton), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
36' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
34' The game is interrupted. Tomas Soucek (West Ham) suffers a horrific injury!
34' West Ham couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Bart Verbruggen (Brighton) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
31' Ball possession – 87:13.
29' Evan Ferguson (Brighton) receives a lofted pass from out wide and shoots from close range, but the ball flies way over the crossbar.
27' Corner kick. Pascal Gross (Brighton) is ready to send the ball into the box.
26' Pascal Gross (Brighton) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
25' Solly March (Brighton) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
24' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Anthony Taylor had an easy-decision to make.
21' Evan Ferguson (Brighton) latches onto the ball after a scramble in the box, but his placed effort towards the bottom left corner is far too weak and Alphonse Areola makes a simple save.
19' 0 - 1 James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) connects with a pass inside the box and slams home into the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper was helpless.
18' Solly March (Brighton) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
16' Billy Gilmour (Brighton) has a chance after receiving a pass. He measures his shot from the edge of the box but it sails just wide of the left post.
13' A lofted cross from Edson Alvarez (West Ham) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
11' Pascal Gross (Brighton) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
10' Michail Antonio (West Ham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
10' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
8' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
6' Michail Antonio (West Ham) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Bart Verbruggen is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
5' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
2' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it just over the bar.
